statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low after an orderly, little-changed Sunday futures reopening while geopolitical Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Current evidence supports a low-Tail classification; the next material reassessment points are whether overnight NQ develops persistent directional efficiency and Monday's macro/cash-open cluster.
headline: Orderly Sunday reopening keeps Tail low despite extreme headline Stress
body: Fresh Sunday futures evidence shows major U.S. index futures little changed to fractionally higher. Fresh shared Finviz context is delayed/supporting-only and shows NQ +0.21%, ES +0.07%, VIX futures +0.58% and WTI essentially flat. This mix does not verify a no-retracement Nasdaq path. Hormuz disruption remains unresolved, keeping Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 published hourly assessments remained green/EA_ON. Tail held near 18% and reached 19% at the Sunday reopen, while Stress rose from 84% to 90% as geopolitical risk accumulated without verified persistent Nasdaq structure.
outlookSummary: Overnight risk should moderate if reopening trade stays two-sided. The next concentrated conditional window is 12:25-14:30 UTC around Empire State, the U.S. cash open and NAHB; Tail only escalates if observed price structure confirms persistent extension or failed retracements.
